briefings.title: Apple WWDC 2026 June 8: Introducing Siri AI and more
briefings.tldr: At WWDC 2026, Apple unveiled its next generation of Apple Intelligence, featuring "Siri AI"—a deeply conversational, privacy-first assistant built in collaboration with Google—alongside macOS Golden Gate, expanded family safety controls, and massive system performance upgrades.

briefings.title: Tim Cook’s Impeccable Timing | Stratechery by Ben Thompson
briefings.tldr: Tim Cook’s 15-year tenure as Apple CEO transitioned the company from a "zero-to-one" innovator under Steve Jobs to a "1-to-n" operational juggernaut, increasing Apple's valuation from $297 billion to $4 trillion while leaving behind critical long-term questions regarding AI and China.

briefings.title: Extended interview: Tim Cook
briefings.tldr: Apple’s enduring success is rooted in a unique culture of collaboration and "insanely great" product focus established by Steve Jobs, which Tim Cook has expanded by integrating modern social values and navigating the complexities of massive global scale.
